ingredients.name: Thai green curry paste
ingredients.notes: Indicative per-100g draft; often contains shrimp paste

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: Indicative per-100g draft; often contains shrimp paste

ingredients.name: Kimchi
ingredients.notes: Indicative per-100g draft; often contains fish sauce/shrimp

ingredients.name: Basil pesto
ingredients.notes: Indicative per-100g draft; contains pine nuts and cheese

ingredients.name: Soba noodles (dry)
ingredients.notes: Indicative per-100g draft; most soba is a buckwheat-wheat blend

recipes.description: Whole-wheat toast topped with lemony mashed avocado and a fried egg.

instructions.text: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper; spread over the toast.
Fry the egg in olive oil and place on top; finish with chili flakes if using.
instructions.safetyNote: cook egg until the white is fully set

recipes.description: A simple sandwich of sliced hard-cooked egg and avocado on white bread with a little mayo.

instructions.text: Boil the egg for 9-10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
instructions.safetyNote: cook egg until yolk is fully set

instructions.text: Spread butter and mayonnaise on the bread slices; layer avocado and egg, season with salt and pepper, close and serve.

recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs served over toast topped with sliced avocado.

instructions.text: Toast the bread and top with sliced or lightly smashed avocado.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper; scramble gently in butter over low heat until just set.
instructions.safetyNote: cook eggs until softly set, no runny white

instructions.text: Pile the scrambled eggs over the avocado toast and serve.

recipes.description: Roman pasta tossed with crisped bacon, eggs, Parmesan and black pepper.

instructions.text: Dice the bacon and cook in olive oil until crisp; remove from heat.
Whisk the eggs with grated Parmesan and black pepper.
Toss the hot cooked spaghetti with the bacon off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture so it forms a creamy sauce without scrambling.
instructions.safetyNote: egg sauce should thicken to a safe temperature; avoid raw-egg serving for at-risk groups

recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef and tomato ragu served over spaghetti.

instructions.text: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in olive oil, 8 minutes.
Add the ground beef and brown well, breaking up lumps.
instructions.safetyNote: cook ground beef through, no pink remaining

instructions.text: Stir in tomato paste, canned tomatoes and milk; simmer 30 minutes.
Toss with cooked spaghetti and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.description: Pasta in a simple tomato, garlic and basil sauce.

instructions.text: Sizzle the garlic in olive oil for 1 minute; add canned tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes.
Season, tear in the basil and toss with the cooked pasta.
Serve with Parmesan if using.

recipes.description: Pasta in a spicy tomato sauce with garlic and red chili.

instructions.text: Fry garlic and chili flakes in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes; season.
Toss with cooked pasta and finish with parsley.

recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed with garlic gently cooked in olive oil and chili flakes.

instructions.text: Slice garlic thinly and warm in olive oil over low heat until just golden.
Add chili flakes, then toss with cooked pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley; add Parmesan if using.

recipes.description: Fettuccine coated in a butter, cream and Parmesan sauce.

instructions.text: Melt butter with garlic; pour in the cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in Parmesan until melted; season.
Toss with cooked fettuccine and serve.

recipes.description: Pasta tossed with basil pesto and a little pasta water.

instructions.text: Loosen the pesto with olive oil and a splash of hot pasta water.
Toss with the drained cooked pasta off the heat; season.
Serve with grated Parmesan.

recipes.description: Layered pasta sheets with beef ragu, bechamel, mozzarella and Parmesan baked until bubbling.

instructions.text: Soften onion in olive oil; brown the ground beef, then add marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Make a bechamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, then milk; simmer until thick.
Layer sheets, ragu, bechamel and mozzarella in a dish; top with Parmesan.
Bake at 180C for 35-40 minutes until golden; rest 10 minutes before slicing.
instructions.safetyNote: bake until piping hot in the center

recipes.description: Creamy Arborio rice cooked slowly with mushrooms, broth, butter and Parmesan.

instructions.text: Soften onion and garlic in olive oil and half the butter; add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes.
Add the rice, toast 1 minute, then add warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes until creamy.
Beat in remaining butter and Parmesan; season and rest 2 minutes.

recipes.description: Pizza base topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, basil and olive oil.

instructions.text: Spread marinara over the pizza base, leaving a rim.
Top with torn mozzarella and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake at the highest oven temperature (about 230C) for 10-14 minutes; finish with basil.
instructions.safetyNote: bake until the base is cooked through and cheese is bubbling

recipes.description: Vegetable, bean and pasta soup in a tomato broth.

instructions.text: Soften onion, carrot and celery in olive oil for 6 minutes; add garlic and oregano for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth and zucchini; simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans and cooked pasta; warm through 5 minutes and season.

recipes.description: Sliced tomatoes and mozzarella with basil, olive oil and balsamic.

instructions.text: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella; arrange alternately on a plate.
Scatter basil, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic, season and serve.

recipes.description: Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic and topped with chopped tomatoes and basil.

instructions.text: Toast or grill the baguette slices until crisp; rub with cut garlic.
Mix chopped tomatoes with olive oil, basil and salt.
Spoon the tomato mix over the toast and serve immediately.

recipes.description: Breaded chicken breast baked with marinara and melted mozzarella.

instructions.text: Pound chicken to even thickness; coat in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil until golden on both sides.
Top with marinara and cheeses; bake at 200C for 12-15 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.description: Layered fried eggplant, marinara and cheeses baked until golden.

instructions.text: Slice eggplant, salt and rest 15 minutes; pat dry.
Coat slices in egg then breadcrumbs; fry in olive oil until golden.
Layer eggplant with marinara, mozzarella and Parmesan in a baking dish.
Bake at 190C for 25-30 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with whipped mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa.

instructions.text: Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale; fold in mascarpone, then whipped egg whites.
instructions.safetyNote: contains raw eggs - use pasteurized eggs

instructions.text: Briefly dip ladyfingers in cooled espresso and layer in a dish with the cream.
Chill at least 4 hours; dust with cocoa before serving.

recipes.description: Pillowy potato gnocchi tossed in tomato sauce with basil and Parmesan.

instructions.text: Simmer the marinara with olive oil for 5 minutes.
Boil gnocchi until they float, 2-3 minutes; drain.
Toss gnocchi in the sauce; serve with basil and Parmesan.

recipes.description: Fresh cheese ravioli simmered and served with marinara and Parmesan.

instructions.text: Warm the marinara with olive oil.
Simmer ravioli in gently boiling water per pack time, about 3-4 minutes; drain carefully.
instructions.safetyNote: cook filled pasta until piping hot

instructions.text: Serve topped with sauce and Parmesan.

recipes.description: Corn tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, onion, tomato, cilantro and lime.

instructions.text: Season chicken with taco seasoning and salt; sear in oil until cooked through, then chop.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with chicken, onion, tomato and cilantro; finish with lime.

recipes.description: Corn tortillas filled with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, tomato and cheddar.

instructions.text: Brown the ground beef in oil; add taco seasoning and a splash of water and simmer 3 minutes.
instructions.safetyNote: cook ground beef through, no pink

instructions.text: Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, onion and cheddar.

recipes.description: Crispy fish in corn tortillas with shredded cabbage and lime crema.

instructions.text: Mix sour cream with lime juice and a pinch of salt for the crema; shred the cabbage.
Dust fish strips with seasoned flour and fry in oil until golden.
instructions.safetyNote: cook fish until opaque, about 63C internal

instructions.text: Warm tortillas; fill with fish, cabbage and crema; add cilantro.

recipes.description: Flour tortillas wrapped around refried beans, rice, cheddar and sour cream.

instructions.text: Warm the refried beans and the rice.
Warm tortillas until pliable.
Fill with beans, rice, cheddar, sour cream, lettuce and tomato; roll up tightly.

recipes.description: Large flour tortillas stuffed with seasoned chicken, rice, black beans and cheese.

instructions.text: Cook seasoned chicken in oil until done; slice.
Warm beans, rice and tortillas.
Fill tortillas with chicken, rice, beans, cheese, tomato, onion and sour cream; roll and toast seam-side down.

recipes.description: Seasoned chicken over rice with black beans, corn, pico-style salsa and avocado.

instructions.text: Cook seasoned chicken in oil; rest and slice.
Mix tomato, onion, cilantro and lime for a quick salsa.
Layer rice, beans, corn and lettuce in bowls; top with chicken, salsa and avocado.

recipes.description: Seared chicken and peppers with warm flour tortillas and sour cream.

instructions.text: Sear seasoned chicken strips in oil until cooked; remove.
Stir-fry the peppers and onion until softened and charred at the edges.
Return chicken to the pan, squeeze in lime; serve with warm tortillas and sour cream.

recipes.description: Flour tortilla filled with melted cheddar, folded and toasted.

instructions.text: Scatter cheddar over one half of the tortilla; fold over.
Toast in a buttered pan until golden and the cheese melts, 2-3 minutes per side.

recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken, baked under enchilada sauce and cheese.

instructions.text: Poach or sear the chicken until cooked; shred.
Soften tortillas in a little warm sauce, fill with chicken and roll.
Arrange in a dish, cover with enchilada sauce and cheddar; bake at 190C for 15-18 minutes.
Serve with sour cream, onion and cilantro.

recipes.description: Fried tortilla pieces simmered in red sauce, topped with chicken, cheese, egg and crema.

instructions.text: Cut tortillas into wedges and fry in oil until crisp.
Add enchilada sauce and simmer 3-4 minutes until the chips soften slightly; fold in cooked chicken.
Fry the eggs separately and place on top with cheddar, sour cream, onion and cilantro.
instructions.safetyNote: cook eggs until whites are set

recipes.description: Mashed avocado with lime, onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno.

instructions.text: Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt to a chunky texture.
Fold in onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno; taste for salt.

recipes.description: Rice toasted then simmered with tomato, onion and garlic.

instructions.text: Blend tomato, onion and garlic into a puree.
Toast the dry rice in oil until golden, 5 minutes.
Add puree, broth, cumin and salt; simmer covered 18 minutes, adding peas and carrot in the last 5 minutes.

recipes.description: Cooked black beans simmered with onion, garlic, cumin and oregano.

instructions.text: Soften onion and garlic in olive oil; add cumin and oregano.
Add the beans with a splash of water; simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few.
Season and finish with lime juice.

recipes.description: Fresh salsa of diced tomato, onion, jalapeno, cilantro and lime.

instructions.text: Dice tomato, onion and jalapeno; chop cilantro.
Combine with lime juice and salt; rest 10 minutes for flavors to meld.

recipes.description: Pork and hominy stew in a red-chili broth, served with cabbage, radish and lime.

instructions.text: Simmer the pork with half the onion and garlic in water until tender, about 60 minutes; skim as needed.
Stir in chili powder and oregano; add drained hominy and simmer 15 minutes.
Season; serve bowls topped with cabbage, radish, remaining onion and lime.

recipes.description: Classic soft scrambled eggs cooked gently in butter.

instructions.text: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Cook in butter over low heat, stirring, until softly set.
instructions.safetyNote: cook eggs until just set, no liquid white

recipes.description: Toasted whole-wheat bread topped with smashed avocado, lemon and chili.

instructions.text: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper; spread over toast, drizzle with oil and chili flakes.

recipes.description: Fried egg sandwich on white bread with mayo.

instructions.text: Toast the bread and spread with mayo.
Fry the egg in butter to your liking; assemble and season.
instructions.safetyNote: cook egg until white is set

recipes.description: Three-egg omelet folded over melted cheddar.

instructions.text: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Cook in butter until almost set; add cheddar, fold and slide onto a plate.
instructions.safetyNote: cook until egg is set through

recipes.description: Fluffy griddle pancakes served with maple syrup.

instructions.text: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar and salt; add milk, egg and melted butter into a batter.
Cook ladles of batter on a buttered griddle until bubbles form; flip and cook the second side.
instructions.safetyNote: cook through; no wet batter in the center

instructions.text: Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.description: Rolled oats simmered with milk, topped with banana, honey and cinnamon.

instructions.text: Simmer oats in milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Top with sliced banana, honey and cinnamon.

recipes.description: Marinated chicken breast grilled with paprika, garlic and lemon.

instructions.text: Marinate chicken in oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through; rest 5 minutes.

recipes.description: Diced cooked chicken folded with mayonnaise, celery and lemon.

instructions.text: Dice the cooked chicken and celery; mince the onion.
Fold with mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper; chill briefly and serve.

recipes.description: Pan-cooked turkey breast on whole-wheat bread with mayo, mustard, lettuce and tomato.

instructions.text: Season turkey and pan-cook 4-5 minutes per side until done; slice.
Spread bread with mayo and mustard; layer turkey, lettuce and tomato.

recipes.description: Seasoned beef patties on buns with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and condiments.

instructions.text: Form the beef into two patties; season with salt and pepper.
Cook patties in a little oil 4-5 minutes per side; melt cheddar on top.
instructions.safetyNote: ground beef to at least 71C internal

instructions.text: Toast the buns; assemble with lettuce, tomato, onion, ketchup and mayo.

recipes.description: Homemade black bean patties on buns with lettuce and tomato.

instructions.text: Mash the beans; mix with onion, breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and salt; form two patties.
Pan-fry patties in oil 4-5 minutes per side until crisp.
Toast buns and assemble with lettuce, tomato and ketchup.

recipes.description: Baked macaroni in a cheddar-milk sauce with a breadcrumb top.

instructions.text: Make a roux with butter and flour; whisk in milk and simmer until thick.
Melt in the cheddar; season and fold in the cooked pasta.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake at 190C for 15-18 minutes until golden.

recipes.description: Boiled potatoes mashed with butter and milk.

instructions.text: Boil peeled potato chunks in salted water until tender, 15-18 minutes.
Drain well; mash with butter and warm milk; season.

recipes.description: Ground beef and beans simmered with tomatoes and chili spices.

instructions.text: Soften onion, pepper and garlic in oil; add beef and brown.
Add chili powder, cumin, tomato paste, tomatoes and beans; simmer 30 minutes.
Season and serve.

recipes.description: Salmon fillets grilled with lemon, garlic and dill.

instructions.text: Rub salmon with oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Grill 4-5 minutes per side until just opaque; finish with dill.

recipes.description: Day-old style rice stir-fried with egg, peas, carrot and scallions.

instructions.text: Scramble the eggs in oil; set aside.
Stir-fry carrot and peas 3 minutes; add rice and break up clumps.
Return egg; season with soy sauce and sesame oil; toss with scallions.

recipes.description: Rice stir-fried with carrot, peas, cabbage and scallions.

instructions.text: Stir-fry carrot, peas and cabbage in oil 4 minutes.
Add rice and toss until hot; push aside and scramble the optional egg.
Season with soy and sesame oil; add scallions.

recipes.description: Rice stir-fried with diced chicken, egg, peas and scallions.

instructions.text: Sear diced chicken in oil until cooked; set aside.
Scramble the egg; add carrot and peas, then rice and chicken.
Season with soy and sesame; toss with scallions.

recipes.description: Crisped egg noodles stir-fried with cabbage, carrots and bean sprouts.

instructions.text: Boil the noodles until just done; drain well.
Stir-fry garlic, cabbage and carrot; add noodles and let them crisp slightly.
Add bean sprouts, scallions, soy, oyster sauce, sugar and sesame; toss.

recipes.description: Soft egg noodles tossed with chicken and vegetables in a savory sauce.

instructions.text: Boil noodles until just tender; drain.
Sear chicken strips until cooked; add pepper and carrot.
Toss in noodles with soy, oyster sauce and sesame; finish with scallions.

recipes.description: Diced chicken stir-fried with peanuts, chili and a sweet-sour soy glaze.

instructions.text: Marinate chicken in half the soy and cornstarch for 10 minutes.
Stir-fry chicken until nearly done; add garlic, ginger, chilies and pepper.
Add the sauce (soy, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch slurry) and peanuts; toss until glossy; add scallions.

recipes.description: Silken tofu simmered in a spicy, fermented-bean flavored sauce with minced pork (bean paste approximated with miso and sriracha).

instructions.text: Brown the pork in oil; add garlic, ginger, chili flakes, miso and sriracha.
Add broth and soy; slide in cubed tofu and simmer 5 minutes.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry; finish with scallions and sesame oil.

aliases: sweet and sour chicken with pineapple
recipes.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed with peppers and pineapple in a sweet-sour sauce.

instructions.text: Coat chicken in egg then cornstarch; shallow-fry until crisp and cooked.
Stir-fry onion and pepper; add pineapple.
Mix ketchup, vinegar, sugar and soy; add to the pan, thicken, then toss in the chicken.

recipes.description: Broccoli, carrot, pepper and mushrooms stir-fried with garlic and oyster sauce.

instructions.text: Heat oil; add garlic, then carrot and broccoli with a splash of water; cover 2 minutes.
Add pepper and mushrooms; stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Season with soy, oyster sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.description: Pork and cabbage dumplings, boiled or pan-steamed.

instructions.text: Mix minced pork with cabbage, scallions, ginger, garlic, soy and sesame oil.
Fill and pleat the wrappers.
Boil in batches until they float and the filling is cooked, about 6-8 minutes (or pan-fry then steam).
instructions.safetyNote: pork filling to at least 63C internal

recipes.description: Peppery, vinegary soup with tofu, mushrooms, bamboo shoots and egg ribbons.

instructions.text: Bring the broth to a simmer; add mushrooms, bamboo shoots and tofu.
Season with soy, vinegar, pepper and chili; thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Drizzle in beaten egg for ribbons; finish with sesame oil and scallions.
instructions.safetyNote: egg ribbons should set in the hot soup

recipes.description: Glazed chicken in a soy-sugar teriyaki sauce over rice (mirin approximated with rice vinegar and sugar).

instructions.text: Mix soy, sugar and rice vinegar into a glaze.
Sear chicken thighs in oil until nearly done; add garlic and ginger.
Pour in the glaze and reduce until glossy; slice and serve over rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.description: Pan-glazed salmon fillets in teriyaki sauce served over rice.

instructions.text: Mix soy, sugar and rice vinegar.
Sear salmon skin-side down; flip and add the glaze and ginger.
Reduce glaze until sticky; serve over rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.description: Inside-out rolls of seasoned rice, imitation crab, avocado, cucumber and sesame.

instructions.text: Season the cooked rice with rice vinegar and sugar; cool to warm.
Lay nori on a mat, spread rice, sprinkle sesame; flip and add crab, avocado, cucumber and a little cream cheese and mayo.
Roll tightly, slice into pieces; serve with soy sauce.

recipes.description: Seasoned rice balls wrapped with nori, with optional flaked salmon center.

instructions.text: If using salmon, pan-cook it and flake; let the rice cool to handling temperature.
With damp salted hands, form rice into triangles, tucking salmon inside if using.
Wrap each with a strip of nori.

recipes.description: Classic soup of dashi-style broth, miso, tofu and scallions.

instructions.text: Bring the water to a gentle simmer; add tofu and torn nori.
Off the heat, dissolve in the miso through a strainer; do not boil.
Add scallions and serve.

recipes.description: Ramen noodles in chicken-soy broth topped with chicken, egg, corn and scallions.

instructions.text: Simmer broth with garlic, soy and sesame; keep hot.
Poach or sear the chicken until cooked; slice. Soft-boil the eggs 6-7 minutes.
Cook the noodles in the broth; assemble bowls with chicken, halved eggs, corn, scallions and nori.

recipes.description: Thick udon noodles stir-fried with pork, cabbage and a savory sauce.

instructions.text: Loosen the udon in hot water; drain.
Sear the pork; add cabbage and carrot.
Add udon, soy, oyster sauce and sesame; toss; finish with scallions.

recipes.description: Chilled soba with a light soy dipping sauce, scallions and nori.

instructions.text: Boil the soba per pack time; rinse under cold water and drain well.
Mix soy, sugar and water for the dipping sauce.
Serve noodles topped with nori and sesame; dip into the sauce with scallions.

recipes.description: Crisp breaded chicken cutlet sliced over rice and cabbage with a quick sauce.

instructions.text: Coat chicken in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry until deep golden and cooked through; rest and slice.
Mix ketchup, soy and a pinch of sugar for a quick sauce; serve over rice and shredded cabbage.

recipes.description: Thick, mild curry of chicken, potato and carrot built on a flour-butter roux, served over rice.

instructions.text: Sear chicken; add onion, carrot and potato and soften 5 minutes.
Add water and simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Make a roux: melt butter, whisk in flour and curry powder; stir into the pot and thicken 5 minutes.
Season and serve over rice.

recipes.description: Sweet-savory rolled omelet made in layers.

instructions.text: Whisk eggs with sugar and soy sauce.
In an oiled pan, add a thin layer of egg; when nearly set, roll it up. Repeat with remaining egg, rolling onto the log.
Rest, then slice.

recipes.description: Rice noodles stir-fried with shrimp, egg, tamarind, peanuts and bean sprouts.

instructions.text: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until pliable; drain.
Sear shrimp in oil until just cooked; push aside and scramble the egg.
Add noodles and sauce (tamarind, fish sauce, sugar); toss; add sprouts and scallions.
Serve with peanuts, lime and chili.

recipes.description: Wide rice noodles wok-fried with chicken, broccoli, egg and a caramelized soy sauce.

instructions.text: Soak the noodles until pliable; drain.
Sear chicken in oil; add garlic, then push aside and scramble the egg.
Add broccoli and noodles with soy, oyster sauce and sugar; char lightly.

recipes.description: Chicken simmered in green curry paste and coconut milk with eggplant and basil, served with rice.

instructions.text: Fry the curry paste in oil and the thick top of the coconut milk for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and coat; pour in the rest of the coconut milk.
Add eggplant and pepper; simmer until tender; season with fish sauce and sugar; add basil.
Serve over rice.

recipes.description: Red curry of chicken and bamboo shoots in coconut milk, served with rice.

instructions.text: Fry the red curry paste in oil and a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.
Add chicken, coat, then the remaining coconut milk.
Add bamboo shoots and pepper; simmer; season with fish sauce and sugar; add basil.
Serve over rice.

recipes.description: Hot-and-sour shrimp soup with lemongrass, galangal-style ginger, lime and chili.

instructions.text: Simmer water with lemongrass and ginger (galangal approximation) for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomato; simmer 3 minutes; add shrimp and cook until just opaque.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili, scallions and cilantro.

recipes.description: Chicken and mushrooms in a fragrant coconut broth with lemongrass and lime.

instructions.text: Simmer water with lemongrass and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk and chicken; simmer gently until cooked through.
Add mushrooms 3 minutes; season with fish sauce and lime; add chili and cilantro.

recipes.description: Chopped chicken wok-fried with chilies, garlic and plenty of basil over rice.

instructions.text: Pound or chop garlic and chilies; fry in oil until fragrant.
Add chopped chicken and stir-fry until cooked.
Season with soy, oyster, fish sauce and sugar; wilt in the basil; serve over rice with a fried egg if using.

recipes.description: Fried rice with pineapple, shrimp, cashews and a hint of curry powder.

instructions.text: Sear shrimp until just cooked; scramble the egg in the same pan.
Add onion, peas and pineapple; toss 2 minutes.
Add rice, curry powder and soy; toss until hot; finish with cashews and scallions.

recipes.description: Sweet coconut sticky rice served with fresh mango and sesame.

instructions.text: Soak the sticky rice 30 minutes, then steam until tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt; fold most of it into the hot rice and rest 10 minutes.
Serve rice with sliced mango, the remaining coconut milk and sesame.

recipes.description: Hummus topped with chickpeas, cucumber-tomato salad, olive oil and warm pita.

instructions.text: Spread the hummus in a shallow bowl; top with whole chickpeas.
Toss cucumber and tomato with lemon and salt; pile alongside.
Drizzle with olive oil, dust with paprika and cumin; serve with warm pita.

recipes.description: Herbed chickpea patties fried and served in pita with tahini and salad.

instructions.text: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices and flour into a coarse paste; rest 10 minutes.
Form balls or patties; fry in oil until deep golden.
instructions.safetyNote: fry until crisp and hot inside

instructions.text: Stuff into warm pita with tomato, lettuce and tahini sauce.

recipes.description: Spiced yogurt-marinated chicken sliced into pita with tahini and salad.

instructions.text: Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, garlic, lemon and oil for at least 20 minutes.
Sear or roast the chicken until cooked; rest and slice thinly.
Fill warm pita with chicken, tomato, cucumber, onion and a drizzle of tahini.

recipes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken skewers grilled with peppers and onions.

instructions.text: Marinate chicken cubes in yogurt, lemon, garlic and spices for 15 minutes.
Thread onto skewers with pepper and onion; grill or broil 10-12 minutes, turning.
Serve with warm pita.

recipes.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, olives and feta dressed with olive oil and oregano.

instructions.text: Chunk the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and onion.
Add olives and feta; dress with oil, lemon, oregano and salt.

recipes.description: Thick yogurt dip with grated cucumber, garlic, dill and lemon.

instructions.text: Grate the cucumber, salt lightly and squeeze out excess water.
Stir into the yogurt with garlic, dill, lemon and olive oil; chill briefly.

recipes.description: Parsley-forward salad with bulgur, tomato, mint, lemon and olive oil.

instructions.text: Soak the bulgur in hot water 15 minutes; fluff and cool.
Chop the parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and scallions.
Combine with lemon, oil and salt; rest before serving.

recipes.description: Chopped salad with toasted pita pieces, radish, herbs and a lemony dressing (sumac approximated with extra lemon).

instructions.text: Toast or fry the pita pieces until crisp.
Chop lettuce, tomato, cucumber, radish, pepper and parsley.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt; fold in the pita just before serving.

recipes.description: Red lentil soup with carrot, tomato, cumin and lemon.

instructions.text: Soften onion, carrot and celery in olive oil; add garlic and cumin.
Add lentils, tomatoes and water; simmer 25-30 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Season, add lemon and spinach if using; serve.

recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

instructions.text: Soften pepper and onion in oil; add garlic, paprika, cumin and chili.
Add tomatoes and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook until whites set; crumble feta if using.
instructions.safetyNote: cook eggs until whites are fully set

aliases: lentils and rice with caramelized onions
recipes.description: Lentils and rice topped with deeply caramelized onions.

instructions.text: Simmer the lentils in water 12 minutes; add the rice and cook until both are tender, about 15 more minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the onions slowly in olive oil until deep brown and sweet, about 20 minutes.
Fold half the onions into the lentil-rice; season with cumin and salt; top with the rest.

recipes.description: Smoky roasted eggplant dip with tahini, lemon and garlic.

instructions.text: Roast the eggplant at 220C, turning, until collapsed and charred, about 30 minutes; cool.
Scoop out the flesh, drain briefly, then mash with tahini, lemon, garlic, cumin and salt.
Finish with olive oil and parsley.

recipes.description: Rice topped with seasoned beef and vegetables, a fried egg, kimchi and gochujang.

instructions.text: Blanch the spinach and sprouts; season with sesame oil and salt.
Sear the carrot and mushrooms separately; then brown the beef with garlic and soy.
Fry the eggs; assemble bowls of rice with the toppings, kimchi and gochujang.
instructions.safetyNote: cook egg to preference; fully set for at-risk groups

recipes.description: Thin-sliced beef marinated in soy, sugar, sesame and grated apple, seared and served over rice.

instructions.text: Mix soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and grated apple; marinate the beef 20 minutes.
Sear the beef with onion in batches until caramelized.
Serve over rice with scallions and sesame.

recipes.description: Chicken and rice-noodle soup in a spiced broth with herbs, sprouts and lime.

instructions.text: Char the onion and ginger; simmer with the broth, star anise and cinnamon for 25 minutes; strain.
Poach the chicken in the broth until cooked; shred.
Soak the noodles; assemble bowls with noodles, chicken and broth; serve with sprouts, basil, lime, jalapeno, hoisin and sriracha.

recipes.description: Baguette sandwich with lemongrass-soy chicken, pickled carrot and radish, cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

instructions.text: Pickle the carrot and radish in rice vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Cook the chicken with soy in a little oil; slice.
Split the baguette, spread with mayo, fill with chicken, pickles, cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

recipes.description: Slow-simmered eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomatoes with garlic and herbs.

instructions.text: Soften the onion and peppers in olive oil; add garlic.
Add the eggplant and zucchini; cook 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and herbs; simmer gently 20-25 minutes until melded.
Season and finish with basil.

recipes.description: Shortcrust tart filled with bacon and a cheese-egg-cream custard.

instructions.text: Blind-bake the crust at 190C for 12 minutes.
Crisp the bacon; scatter with onion and cheese in the crust.
Whisk eggs and cream; pour over and bake 25-30 minutes until just set.
instructions.safetyNote: bake until the custard is set, about 71C in the center

recipes.description: Saffron rice cooked with chicken, shrimp, peppers and peas in a wide pan.

instructions.text: Brown the chicken in olive oil; add pepper, onion, garlic, paprika and tomato; cook down.
Add the rice, saffron and hot broth; simmer without stirring about 15 minutes.
Nestle in the shrimp and peas; cook until shrimp are opaque and the rice is tender.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat.

recipes.description: Thick omelet of slowly fried potatoes and onion set in eggs.

instructions.text: Cook the sliced potatoes and onion gently in olive oil until tender, about 15 minutes; drain, reserving a little oil.
Mix with the beaten eggs and salt; rest 5 minutes.
Cook in a film of oil until the bottom sets; flip and finish the other side.
instructions.safetyNote: cook until the egg is set in the center

recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs folded into a tomato-pepper sauce, topped with feta.

instructions.text: Soften the peppers and chilies in olive oil; add tomatoes and simmer until saucy.
Season, pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set; crumble in the feta.

recipes.description: Spiced red lentil stew cooked with onion, tomato and berbere, served over rice.

instructions.text: Cook the onions slowly in oil until very soft; add garlic and ginger.
Add the berbere and tomato; cook down 5 minutes.
Add the lentils and water; simmer until thick and soft, about 20 minutes; season.
Serve over rice (injera traditionally).

recipes.description: Black beans slow-simmered with pork, sausage and bacon, served with rice and orange.

instructions.text: Soften the onion and garlic; add the pork, sausage and bacon and brown.
Add the beans, bay leaves and water; simmer until rich and thick, about 60-75 minutes.
Season; serve over rice with orange slices.

recipes.description: Chicken marinated in jerk seasoning, lime and aromatics, grilled and served with rice.

instructions.text: Blend the jerk seasoning with lime, garlic, ginger, soy and oil; marinate the chicken at least 20 minutes.
Grill or roast the chicken until charred at the edges and cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Rest, then serve over rice.

recipes.description: Battered white fish and thick-cut fried potatoes.

instructions.text: Cut potatoes into chips; fry in oil until golden and tender, about 15 minutes; drain and salt.
Whisk flour, baking powder, water and salt into a batter.
Dip the fish in batter and fry until deep golden and crisp.

recipes.description: Browned pork sausages served on warmed sauerkraut with boiled potatoes and mustard.

instructions.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
Brown the sausages in oil; add the onion and soften.
Add the sauerkraut and a splash of water; cover and warm through; serve with mustard.
